The mixed objective combines the operational structure of PV forecasting with random sequence reconstruction and provides the most balanced performance across forecasting accuracy, degraded NWP conditions, and downstream adaptation. Experiments on 479 distributed PV stations use 340 stations for model development and 139 spatially held-out stations for zero-shot evaluation. Across horizons from 6 hours to 7 days, the multi-site pretrained MR model outperforms representative station-specific and shared baselines, as well as generalist time-series models, including a recent large-scale pretrained foundation model. The pretrained model can also be directly deployed at new PV stations and subsequently adapted to region-specific operational objectives when local data become available, providing a scalable forecasting paradigm for large distributed PV fleets.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向分布式光伏预测的领域基础式预训练框架，用多站点多时域数据学习共享模型，并支持新站点零样本部署与后续适配。
summary.methods: 将 NWP 辅助预测建模为序列补全，统一历史功率、气象观测、未来 NWP 与时间编码；比较预测对齐重建、通用重建和混合重建三种预训练目标；使用 479 个站点（340 开发、139 空间留出）评估 6 小时至 7 天预测。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练与自监督表示学习在领域时间序列上的应用，与预训练主题相关。
summary.caveat: 评估集中于光伏功率预测这一领域；摘要未报告具体误差数值，零样本与适配结论基于其站点划分。

papers.title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
papers.abstract: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.

summary.takeaway: 提出开源轻量级RAG工具EpiLens，用固定检索模板与输出模式处理流行病学文献，并将输出链接回原文段落以便溯源。
summary.methods: 基于多病原体参数研究的来源构建2,297篇论文语料；在214篇人工标注论文上评估论文分类流程，与监督及零样本基线在四个任务上比较；将327条估计值链接到引用文档或综述收录的研究，并按参数与病原体比较关联论文的模型化比例。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型与检索增强生成方向，用RAG减少LLM转述或混淆来源的问题，并服务于流行病学知识获取。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告单语料、单标注集的分类与链接结果，未说明标注一致性、跨语料泛化或抽取准确性；模型化比例的因果解释未被验证。

papers.title: Rigidity-Aware Geometric Pretraining for Protein Design and Conformational Ensembles
papers.abstract: Generative models have recently advanced de novo protein design by learning the statistical regularities of natural structures. However, current approaches face three key limitations: (1) Existing methods cannot jointly learn protein geometry and design tasks, where pretraining can be a solution; (2) Current pretraining methods mostly rely on local, non-rigid atomic representations for property prediction downstream tasks, limiting global geometric understanding for protein generation tasks; and (3) Existing approaches have yet to effectively model the rich dynamic and conformational information of protein structures. To overcome these issues, we introduce RigidSSL (Rigidity-Aware Self-Supervised Learning}, a geometric pretraining framework that front-loads geometry learning prior to generative finetuning. Phase I (RigidSSL-Perturb) learns geometric priors from 432K structures from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database with simulated perturbations. Phase II (RigidSSL-MD) refines these representations on 1.3K molecular dynamics trajectories to capture physically realistic transitions. Underpinning both phases is a bi-directional, rigidity-aware flow matching objective that jointly optimizes translational and rotational dynamics to maximize mutual information between conformations. Empirically, RigidSSL variants improve designability by up to 43% while enhancing novelty and diversity in unconditional generation. Furthermore, RigidSSL-Perturb improves the success rate by 5.8% in zero-shot motif scaffolding and RigidSSL-MD captures more biophysically realistic conformational ensembles in G protein-coupled receptor modeling. The code is available at: https://github.com/ZhanghanNi/RigidSSL.git.

summary.takeaway: 提出RigidSSL几何自监督预训练框架，在生成式微调前先学习蛋白质几何与构象动力学表征。
summary.methods: 两阶段：RigidSSL-Perturb在AlphaFold DB的432K结构中用模拟扰动学习几何先验；RigidSSL-MD在1.3K条分子动力学轨迹上精炼；核心为双向、刚性感知的flow matching目标，联合优化平移与旋转动力学。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习，面向蛋白质设计与构象集合生成。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的设计性提升幅度、零样本motif scaffolding成功率与GPCR建模评估缺乏基线细节和统计说明，需查看全文确认。

papers.title: Generalizing Multimodal Foundational Models in Context-Driven Class Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to learn new classes continuously without forgetting the previously learned ones. Recent works in CIL have significantly advanced across various modalities; however, at the intersection of audio-visual modality, this problem remains underexplored. While representations from multimodal foundational models (MFMs) encapsulate rich static priors, our preliminary analysis shows that these representations struggle in incremental settings. Motivated by this, we propose a framework that generalizes frozen MFMs to audio-visual CIL. Specifically, we leverage their dense audio and visual representations and employ an attention-based contextual guidance module, in which the audio representations serve as task-stable contextual guidance for the visual representations, enabling effective class recognition in the incremental setting. To further mitigate catastrophic forgetting and preserve stability across tasks, we employ feature- and logit-level distillation, which are primarily responsible for the reduced forgetting. Extensive evaluations across various audio-visual CIL benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/avigupta2798/MFM-CIL.

summary.takeaway: 将冻结的多模态基础模型推广到音视频类增量学习，用音频表示作为任务稳定的上下文引导视觉表示，并用蒸馏缓解遗忘。
summary.methods: 利用冻结MFM的稠密音频与视觉表示，设计基于注意力的上下文引导模块；采用特征级与logit级蒸馏；在多个音视频CIL基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习与多模态基础模型利用，属于检索增强与对齐主题下的表征迁移与稳定性研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出预分析显示MFM表示在增量场景中表现不佳，但未给出具体退化幅度；与检索增强的直接关系较弱，需确认实验设置是否覆盖真实开放场景。

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

summary.takeaway: 提出无回放的持续学习OOD检测框架，基于Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks的局部神经可塑性，并用几何引导的OOD分数补充分类置信度。
summary.methods: 设计任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，按任务控制激活局部性以缓解新近偏差；提出不依赖过去ID数据的几何引导OOD分数；在OOD-CL设置下评估ID分类与OOD检测。
summary.relevance: 对应持续学习与分布外检测，关注无回放条件下的稳定性与可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体数据集、指标数值或与基线的差距，SOTA声明需结合全文实验验证。

papers.title: Vulnerability Analysis for Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement
papers.abstract: Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (SMARL) aims to learn cooperative control policies under prescribed safety constraints. Al- though existing SMARL methods focus on enforcing safety during policy optimization, their vulnerability remains largely unexplored. This paper investigates inference-time observation attacks against SMARL, where an adversary perturbs the observations of a subset of agents, thereby altering the actions produced by their policies. We propose MinMax Attack, an attack framework that jointly selects adversarial target actions for compromised agents while accounting for the Cooperative Resistance of benign agents. We further derive a bound on the induced safety cost and characterize its relation- ship with the Compromised-Agent Budget and the Perturbation Budget. Experiments across multiple safety-critical multi-agent benchmarks and representative state-of-the-art SMARL algorithms show that MinMax Attack induces substantially higher safety costs than existing attack baselines while preserving task reward, thereby reducing its detectability and achieving both attack effectiveness and stealthiness.

summary.takeaway: 研究安全多智能体强化学习在推理时的观测攻击脆弱性，提出MinMax Attack，联合选择被攻陷智能体的目标动作并考虑良性智能体的协同抵抗。
summary.methods: 构建推理时观测扰动攻击框架；推导诱导安全成本上界并分析其与攻陷智能体预算、扰动预算的关系；在多个安全关键多智能体基准和代表性SMARL算法上实验。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习与多智能体安全方向，揭示SMARL策略在部署时的攻击面。
summary.caveat: 摘要限定为推理时观测攻击与特定威胁模型，未讨论防御方法或真实系统验证；上界的紧致性需查看全文。

papers.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation profiling is limited by cost and throughput, while computational methods remain constrained by inconsistent evaluation and underperformance relative to simple baselines. Here we present DCAF, a unified framework for single-cell perturbation simulation that that jointly addresses data validity, evaluation validity and predictive modeling. Among its three components, DCAF-data addresses the single-measurement limitation by reconstructing pre- and post-perturbation status using entropy-regularized optimal transport, and is demonstrated on both cell line and multi-cell type datasets. DCAF-criterion evaluates log fold changes in non-silenced genes to improve sensitivity to model error and robustness to zero inflation noise, validated on synthetic datasets. DCAF-model combines JEPA with explicit modeling for regulatory-dynamics modeling for interpretable prediction. Across benchmarks, DCAF outperforms state-of-the-art deep-learning methods, as well as mean and linear baselines in cross-gene, cross-cell-type and cross-region generalization. In adult Mouse brain, DCAF recapitulates known cell-type-specific regulatory heterogeneity of Dgcr8 knockdown at both cell type and gene levels. DCAF thus provides a rigorous and biologically grounded foundation for reliable perturbation simulation across development, disease and therapeutic discovery.

summary.takeaway: 提出单细胞扰动模拟统一框架DCAF，同时处理数据有效性、评估有效性与预测建模。
summary.methods: DCAF-data用熵正则最优传输重建扰动前后状态；DCAF-criterion基于非沉默基因的log fold change改进评估；DCAF-model结合JEPA与调控动力学显式建模；在细胞系与多细胞类型数据及跨基因、跨细胞类型、跨区域设置中评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动主题，关注扰动响应预测与基准评估方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要称优于现有深度学习方法及均值/线性基线，但未给出具体指标数值；小鼠脑Dgcr8敲低结果仅为重现已知异质性，需全文确认泛化范围。

papers.title: TiSAM: fusing spatial and histopathology foundation models for whole-slide image segmentation
papers.abstract: Semantic segmentation of whole-slide images (WSIs) quantifies tissue composition and architecture, but existing models require extensive annotation and lose accuracy as the number of tissue classes increases or on heterogeneous, cross-scanner datasets. Here, we present the Tissue Segment Anything Model (TiSAM), which fuses SAM3 spatial features with UNI2-h pathology features within a multi-scale decoder. Because public benchmarks contain few tissue classes, we release MegaMouse, comprising 36,833 annotations of 52 tissue classes from 12 mouse organs, and an 11-class human pancreas dataset. TiSAM achieved the highest overall performance across four public datasets compared to existing convolutional neural network and vision transformer models, maintained high accuracy on MegaMouse, and maintained high accuracy in the human pancreas dataset when trained on as few as 5 annotated WSIs where previous integrations of SAM with pathology foundation models did not. TiSAM segmentations were also more consistent across eight slide scanners compared to other models. These results establish TiSAM as a general and highly adaptable framework for tissue segmentation, enabling studies containing many tissue classes, limited annotations, or images from multiple scanners.

summary.takeaway: 提出TiSAM，将SAM3空间特征与UNI2-h病理基础模型特征在多尺度解码器中融合，用于全切片图像语义分割。
summary.methods: 融合两类基础模型特征的多尺度解码器；发布MegaMouse数据集（12个小鼠器官、52类组织、36,833条标注）及11类人胰腺数据集；在四个公共数据集、MegaMouse和人胰腺数据上评估，并比较八台扫描仪的跨扫描仪一致性。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练基础模型在计算病理中的应用，涉及特征融合与少标注适应。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅在组织类别与跨扫描仪一致性上报告优势，未给出分割精度数值；数据集以小鼠为主，人类多类别场景证据有限。

papers.title: Automated Brick Schema Knowledge Graph Completion Across Buildings
papers.abstract: The Brick schema represents building equipment, sensors, spaces, and the relationships between them as typed, multi-relational graphs, providing machine-readable metadata that supports generalizable control applications. Current methods for producing complete Brick models require extensive manual examination of building schematics and point lists. We observe that as Brick models are knowledge graphs, inferring missing relations is naturally posed as a knowledge graph completion problem. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of knowledge graph completion to Brick model generation. We compare three methods, gradient-boosted trees, Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking, and CompGCN, on the relations feeds, hasPart, and hasPoint, which account for the majority of the schematic-reading work in building a Brick model by hand. Models are evaluated on held-out MORTAR buildings and out-of-distribution Kaggle and Building Time Series data. Although CompGCN is the strongest performer on held-out buildings under metrics resistant to class imbalance, leading macro-F1 and AUPRC, no method generalizes uniformly across datasets or relations.

summary.takeaway: 首次将知识图谱补全用于Brick建筑元数据模型生成，比较三种方法补全feeds、hasPart、hasPoint关系。
summary.methods: 将Brick模型缺失关系推断形式化为知识图谱补全；比较梯度提升树、Pairwise Brick Relation Ranking与CompGCN；在留出的MORTAR建筑及分布外的Kaggle与Building Time Series数据上评估，采用macro-F1与AUPRC等指标。
summary.relevance: 对应知识图谱主题，探索建筑领域图谱的自动补全与跨建筑泛化。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确指出没有方法在所有数据集或关系上一致泛化；CompGCN虽在留出建筑上领先，但跨数据集表现不稳定，实际部署需进一步验证。

papers.title: Generative modeling of spatially resolved perturbation responses with CONCERT
papers.abstract: Spatial perturbation transcriptomics measures gene expression responses to genetic or chemical perturbations in intact tissue. Each response depends on the intrinsic state of a cell and on its niche, the neighboring cells through which perturbation effects propagate. Here we present CONCERT a niche-aware Gaussian process variational autoencoder that embeds each perturbation with the niche of the receiving cell and learns a spatial kernel for each perturbation, whose lengthscale sets how far the effect extends in tissue. We evaluate CONCERT in within-niche prediction, for held-out cells in the niche where a perturbation was measured, and in cross-slide prediction, for a slide from which the perturbation was withheld during training. On a SPAC-seq screen of hundreds of knockouts at single-cell resolution and on Perturb-map lung tumors at spot resolution, CONCERT predicts response magnitude and gene ranking more accurately than counterfactual models trained on dissociated cells, spatial perturbation models and spatial nearest neighbor aggregation. In dextran sodium sulfate colitis, where each mouse is sampled once, CONCERT reconstructs spatial gene expression at unmeasured time points, enabling longitudinal comparison that separates changes over time from differences between mice. The predictions recover the nonmonotonic course of injury, which peaks at day 9 and resolves by day 21. In ischemic stroke, CONCERT predicts responses to lesions of different sizes and locations, in single sections and across serial sections in three dimensions, and reproduces the expression patterns of the lesion core and perilesional tissue. Across lung tumor, colon and brain tissue, CONCERT predicts niche-aware counterfactual responses at locations where a perturbation was not measured and reconstructs missing spatial data.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CONCERT，一种考虑细胞邻域的 Gaussian process 变分自编码器，用空间扰动转录组数据预测未测位置的扰动响应并重建缺失空间表达。
summary.methods: 模型为邻域感知的 Gaussian process VAE，将扰动与接收细胞的邻域一起嵌入，并为每个扰动学习一个空间核，其长度尺度决定效应在组织中的传播距离。在 SPAC-seq 单细胞分辨率敲除筛选、Perturb-map 肺肿瘤 spot 数据上评估，并应用于 DSS 结肠炎、缺血性卒中及肺肿瘤/结肠/脑组织。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于多组学扰动方向，将遗传或化学扰动与空间转录组结合，建模扰动响应如何在组织邻域中传播，可用于预测未见位置的扰动反事实响应。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体精度指标、基线差距数值或统计显著性；DSS 结肠炎中每只小鼠仅采样一次，时间点比较依赖模型重建；摘要称预测恢复损伤非单调过程等结论均为模型预测结果，尚需实验验证。
